name: entity-source-tests
goal: Show source and associated test files from the selected revision with working code viewing

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Source must list associated test files as well as implementation and companion files; every code action reads only the selected committed snapshot.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Standard source archive and seven-kind browser coverage only supplied implementation snapshots, so omitted associated tests and their historical bytes. Extend those existing fixtures and assertions.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Immutable f6feade5d6 at 13a876b75 fails the real associated-test archive, Source list and admission assertions, retaining before images for all seven kinds at three widths.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
